issues.title: Add a CSV format to `inventory list`
issues.body:
Add a CSV output to `inventory list`, so that the stock can be opened in a spreadsheet.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `inventory list --format csv stock.txt` prints the header `sku,name,qty,price` and then one row per item, in file order.
- [ ] In a CSV row the price is in dollars with two decimals, for example `A1,bolt,40,0.25`.
- [ ] `inventory list stock.txt` without `--format` prints the same table as before.
- [ ] `inventory list --format xml stock.txt` exits with status 2.
issues.author: maintainer
